# Candy stall: a pink counter, four posts, a red and cream striped awning sloping to the front, a candy-floss cloud
# and three lollipops on the counter, a gold sign board on top. Up Z, front -Y.
new
add mesh cube --name Counter --size 1 --location 0 0 0.5
scale 1.8 0.8 1.0
apply --scale
material new Pink --base-color 1 0.467 0.659
add mesh cube --name Top --size 1 --location 0 -0.05 1.04
scale 1.95 0.95 0.08
apply --scale
material new Cream --base-color 1 0.945 0.910
add mesh cube --name PostFL --size 1 --location -0.85 -0.35 1.55
scale 0.1 0.1 1.0
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name PostFR --size 1 --location 0.85 -0.35 1.55
scale 0.1 0.1 1.0
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name PostBL --size 1 --location -0.85 0.35 1.65
scale 0.1 0.1 1.2
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name PostBR --size 1 --location 0.85 0.35 1.65
scale 0.1 0.1 1.2
apply --scale
material new Wood --base-color 0.671 0.322 0.212 --no-slot
select PostFL PostFR PostBL PostBR
material assign Wood
# the awning: six stripes (a 6 x 2 texture) running front to back, 0.35 wide, sloping 15 degrees down to the front
add mesh cube --name Awning --size 1 --location 0 -0.05 2.15
scale 2.1 1.15 0.1
apply --scale
material new Awning --base-color 1 1 1 --no-slot
material assign Awning
active Awning
mode edit
select all
uv project-from-view top --scale-to-bounds
mode object
material texture Awning base-color textures/awning.png
set rotation -15 0 0
add mesh cube --name Sign --size 1 --location 0 0.38 2.55
scale 1.2 0.1 0.4
apply --scale
material new Gold --base-color 1 0.639 0 --no-slot
material assign Gold
# candy on the counter
add mesh ico-sphere --name Floss --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.22 --location -0.5 -0.1 1.35
material assign Pink
add mesh cylinder --name Stick1 --vertices 4 --radius 0.035 --depth 0.35 --location 0.1 -0.15 1.25
add mesh cylinder --name Stick2 --vertices 4 --radius 0.035 --depth 0.45 --location 0.4 -0.1 1.3
add mesh cylinder --name Stick3 --vertices 4 --radius 0.035 --depth 0.35 --location 0.7 -0.15 1.25
material new Stick --base-color 1 0.945 0.910 --no-slot
select Stick1 Stick2 Stick3
material assign Stick
add mesh cylinder --name Pop1 --vertices 8 --radius 0.16 --depth 0.08 --location 0.1 -0.15 1.5 --rotation 90 0 0
material new Red --base-color 1 0 0.302 --no-slot
material assign Red
add mesh cylinder --name Pop2 --vertices 8 --radius 0.16 --depth 0.08 --location 0.4 -0.1 1.6 --rotation 90 0 0
material new Green --base-color 0 0.894 0.212 --no-slot
material assign Green
add mesh cylinder --name Pop3 --vertices 8 --radius 0.16 --depth 0.08 --location 0.7 -0.15 1.5 --rotation 90 0 0
material new Blue --base-color 0.161 0.678 1 --no-slot
material assign Blue
select all
shade flat
export stall.glb
